mechanics: Supplies (crate icon; GHS character token 'supplies'): gained in steps of 10 - Gain 10 (Bladed Boomerang bottom, Cleave and Thrust bottom, Provisions top, Scroll Case top, Concussive Snare bottom), Gain 20 (Continual Supply top, Bag of Holding bottom), 10 per ally given an item (Giant Club bottom), 10 if the loot takes a money token (Tools of War bottom), 10 at the end of each of your turns (Set Up Shop top, persistent), 30 on each of your next three turns ending with 0 supplies (Continual Supply bottom, use slots). GHS specialActions: supply_tokens_perk (perk 11) and supply_tokens_scenario

Consume supplies (crate icon with a red X, no amount printed on any card), always in a dashed optional box: Recover your items, XP 1 (Readied Blade top, Iron Bulwark top, Quiver of Arrows top); Recover the heal target's items, XP 1 (Sharpening Kit top); Recover your and adjacent allies' items, XP 1 (Continual Supply top, Scroll of Blizzards bottom). Also in persistent text: may consume supplies to Recover the items of an ally who ends a move/teleport adjacent (Set Up Shop top); consuming supplies to Recover an item with gold cost 30+ may also draw a random class item (Proficiency top) - this hints the cost depends on the items' gold cost, but the cards don't say

Recover spent items (card-with-check icon) without supplies: one of your spent items (Booster Pack bottom, Armed to the Teeth bottom), one adjacent ally may Recover one of their spent items (Caustic Bolt bottom, Tools of War top), after the next attack targeting you this round + XP 1 (Scroll of Judgment bottom), at the end of each round (Reinforced Steel bottom, persistent)

Class item supply (round bronze token with the class icon): random draws - 5 random, give to adjacent allies and self, max 3 to self (Booster Pack top), one random to an ally within range 2 at the end of each of your turns (Reinforced Steel top), one random when recovering a 30+ gold item with supplies (Proficiency top); chosen - up to 4 items to allies adjacent to hexes entered during the move (Giant Club bottom)

Named class items given or gained by the cards (stats are on the item cards, not here): Iron Plate (Shield item: Crushing Hammer bottom, Hammer and Anvil top, Proficiency bottom), Barbed Strip (Retaliate item: Scroll of Recall bottom, Hammer and Anvil top, Armed to the Teeth top, Proficiency bottom), Sharpened Dirk (Hastened Step top, Lethal Arsenal top, Armed to the Teeth top), Sturdy Spear (Cleave and Thrust top, Lethal Arsenal top, Hammer and Anvil top, Twin Lances bottom), Scroll of Relocation (Provisions top, Scroll Case bottom), Scroll of Embers (Scroll Case top, Tools of War top), Scroll of Foresight (Scroll Case top, Set Up Shop bottom, Armed to the Teeth bottom), Corrosive Coating (Caustic Bolt top, Scroll of Lightning bottom), Weighted Bolas (Concussive Snare top, Tools of War top)

Give an item 'to gain XP 1' (XP only for giving): Crushing Hammer bottom (ally or self), Hastened Step top, Cleave and Thrust top (ally within range 2), Scroll Case top (Foresight only), Concussive Snare top, Tools of War top, Armed to the Teeth top (ally or self); gives without XP: Caustic Bolt top, Scroll Case top (Embers) and bottom, Hammer and Anvil top, Set Up Shop bottom, Twin Lances bottom

Item modifiers: +1 Attack on all your melee attacks for the turn after the first lost-icon item use each turn (Proficiency top); +1 Retaliate on all Barbed Strip and +1 Shield on all Iron Plate items, and gain one of them whenever you rest (Proficiency bottom)

Use-slot persistent cards: +1 Target on the next four ranged attack abilities of adjacent allies (Quiver of Arrows bottom, 4 slots, XP on 2 and 4, lost); gain 30 supplies on the next three turns ending with 0 supplies (Continual Supply bottom, 3 slots, XP on 1 and 3, lost)
Persistent without lost or slots: Set Up Shop top (supplies each turn, recover adjacent allies' items, mandatory 'cannot perform move abilities')

Party buffs: round Shield 1 to all adjacent allies and self (Iron Bulwark bottom); round +1 Attack on all attacks for you and adjacent allies (Sharpening Kit bottom); round Shield 2 to one adjacent ally or self (Armed to the Teeth top); end-of-round Heal 2 on all allies within range 1 (Set Up Shop bottom)

Non-attack damage: all enemies within range 4 suffer damage 2 after a mandatory damage 2 to yourself (Scroll of Judgment top); mandatory damage 1 to all allies and enemies adjacent to the attack target (Scroll of Lightning top)
Ally-targeted pull and heal: Pull 2 on 1 ally (Scroll of Recall top), Heal 3 on 1 ally (Sharpening Kit top)
Attack whose target is '1 enemy within 2 hexes' with no range icon (Impaling Spear bottom)
Ranged area attack with no grey hex (Scroll of Blizzards top)
Elements: infuse Earth (Scroll of Recall top), infuse Air (Scroll of Lightning top), infuse Ice (Scroll of Blizzards top), each in its own '!' box; no consumes
Conditions used: Stun, Wound, Muddle, plus Pierce and Push/Pull; no summons, no Ward/Safeguard
GHS character data: name three-spears, hand size 11, HP 10/12/14/16/18/20/22/24/26 for levels 1-9, traits armored/resourceful/strong
